name: generated-visual-assets
description: Produce a coherent series of AI-generated illustrations for a product, reproducibly, and give them short motion clips that do not destroy them.

interface.shortDescription: Generate a consistent series of product illustrations.
interface.longDescription: Generated Visual Assets covers the method for producing a coherent series of AI-generated illustrations: a layered prompt that keeps a whole catalogue on one press, versioned runs that make a result traceable to its prompt, a crop contract that serves hero, feed, thumbnail and banner from a single source, and the rules for animating an approved still without losing what made it good.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Generated Visual Assets to set up a reproducible illustration series for this product.
